$description: Platter design tokens v1.1 — Cerulean & Apricot, cooled surfaces (E-26 → E-30). Import as Figma variables or map to a Tailwind theme.

bg.$surfacePaper.note: E-26: planroom / document-sheet surfaces only. 'surface' moved off floral onto page for general work surfaces, superseding the floral assignment in D-12.

accent.$fill.note: E-27: demoted to washes/large surfaces only
accent.$strong.note: E-27: high-emphasis selection, active command bar, focus rings, logo lifted cell

danger.$job: bond, mandatory, overdue, low confidence, destructive

font.$note: E-28: scale bumped one step, line heights unchanged. E-29: chip style added — condensed Archivo, not mono.

chip.$note: E-29: chips/status pills — a chip is a label, not data. Mono is reserved for genuine data via 'data'/'dataLg'.

table.$note: S35: naming for the column filter/hide/reorder/export framework, not the build itself. A table carries data-table-mode set to one of these; each column opts in via data-col-modes (space-separated), and a column with no data-col-modes attribute shows in every mode.

rules: Components reference semantic tokens only. A raw primitive in a component is a bug.
fill is for backgrounds. text is the only value legible as type on light surfaces.
Apricot means selection. It is never decorative. strong is for high-emphasis selection only, fill for washes/large surfaces.
All numerics use the data family with tabular figures. Chips/labels use the chip style, never data.
Confidence thresholds are fixed: high >= 0.90, medium >= 0.70, low < 0.70.
Every component defines hover, focus, disabled, loading, empty and error before shipping.
surfacePaper (Floral White) is reserved for planroom and document-sheet surfaces only — general work surfaces use surface (page).
